id: The Van Der Band-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Van Der Band
long_description:
The Van Der Band is Pōneke’s newest and possibly craziest big band!

This explosive debut will feature all original music by kiwi composers, and explore the crossover between art music and dance music in the modern big band style. Whether you’re a massive jazz nerd or just want to boogie, there’s something for everyone in this polystylistic conglomerate of pure energy.

Music from 9pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band appreciated!

id: The Alex Trask Septet Goes On Holiday-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Alex Trask Septet Goes On Holiday
long_description: Join us for this special gig celebrating our favourite music from this year's gigs: the music of Benny Carter and Duke Ellington! Featuring original arrangements of Ellington classics, transcriptions of Benny Carter's arrangements, and a few Christmas classics. Except tunes from Such Sweet Thunder; Black, Brown, and Beige, the Nutcracker Suite, Further Definitions, and more! The band will showcase every instrument, and there will be a feature from the band's celebrated clarinet trio. The septet is made up of some of Wellington’s top players, including members of the Aotearoa Jazz Orchestra, the Royal New Zealand Air Force Band, New Zealand School of Music—Te Kōkī faculty, and rising stars.

name: Brazza!
long_description:
Brazza! returns to Wellington for a night of Brazilian grooves, infectious rhythms and seriously good vibes. Bringing together a crew of local Brazilian music experts and aficionados, the band dives into the rich sounds of samba, Brazilian jazz and beyond.

Featuring Fabiola Stevenson (vocals), Félicien Houet (guitar), Bryn van Vliet (alto sax), Duncan Taylor (trombone), Peter Hamilton (bass), Marcel Nogueira d’Eurydice (pandeiro/cavaquinho) and Sam MacKenzie (drums).

Expect deep grooves, swinging rhythms and plenty of Brazilian heat — Wellington style.

Music from 9:30pm, FREE ENTRY

id: Lily Atu Presents: Rivering-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Lily Atu Presents: Rivering
long_description:
Rivering at Rogue!

Come celebrate Rivering on the 19th of November with us. If you haven’t had a chance to catch us play yet, this gig is for you, and if you have already supported this project, come along, dance and grab a drink.

The collection of music entitled Rivering is written by saxophonist and vocalist Lily Rose Atu, and is deeply inspired by her love of jazz and neo-soul. It has been workshopped across the year with Jono Ben Zur (bass), Ranu Wijesuriya (drums), and Paulina Hernandez (piano) and has recently been recorded at Massey University.

Special features at this gig include Elisa Bird (clarinet and baritone) Frank Paton (trumpet) and Victoria Ferry (vocals). This will be our last gig with the incredible pianist Paulina who will be heading overseas just a few days after this show. Come and listen to the music we have created together for a final time!

Tickets from $10 at humanitix: https://events.humanitix.com/rivering-compositions-by-lily-rose-atu
Limited door sales: $15

id: Sunday Jazz - Bryn Van Vliet-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Sunday Jazz - Bryn Van Vliet
long_description:
Ex-Wellington saxophonist Bryn van Vliet returns to the capital for an evening of original music, original arrangements and some of his favourite tunes.

With 15 years in the music industry, Bryn has performed and recorded with leading New Zealand artists, international jazz musicians and a wide range of projects spanning jazz, funk, soul and Brazilian music. As a bandleader, arranger and multi-instrumentalist, he brings a distinctive voice shaped by years of collaboration across the local and international music scenes.

id: Cumbia Blazera ¡BLAZE! Album release party & Día de Los Muertos fiesta-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Cumbia Blazera ¡BLAZE! Album release party & Día de Los Muertos fiesta
long_description:
Get ready for the ultimate spooky fiesta! Cumbia Blazera are mixing their signature latino dancefloor bangers with the vibrant, joyful energy of Día de Los Muertos (Day of the Dead) for a night of pure, unadulterated celebration.

Freshly back from a South Island Tour and with a brand-new album to release for you, we can't wait to rock the Rogue again with all you party animals :)

Día de Los Muertos facepainting will be available at the venue on the day for koha and costumes are of course encouraged..

Gather your bones, round up your friends, and secure your tickets before they vanish into thin air. Let’s dance, celebrate, and honour the spirits in true latino style!

id: Alex Trask Electric Quartet-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Alex Trask Electric Quartet
long_description: Local saxophonist Alex Trask presents a brand new electric ensemble! The band will play original music from his various projects, reinterpreting songs that have until now only been been heard acoustically. Inspired by folk music from around the world and infused with jazz performance practice, these tunes create an open and inviting sound that changes depending on the musicians on stage. Featuring the mercurial sounds of electric bass and Rhodes piano contrasted with the warmth of the saxophone. Hiding amongst these tunes will be some swing compositions and arrangements of favourite melodies.

name: Funky Mama
long_description:
Funky Mama has been a staple in the Wellington music diet since 2016. Fresh from treating severe cases of deep vein thrombosis in Tauranga, they’re back in the capital to deliver their signature blend of deep funk, bouncy boogaloo and ’80s house.

Led by saxophonist Bryn van Vliet, Funky Mama are here to get the blood pumping, the hips moving and the circulation flowing. Forget the compression socks — come down for a Thursday night libation and let some of Wellington’s finest funk practitioners get you back on your feet.

Doctor’s orders.

Music from 9:30pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band appreciated!

id: The Racket Lounge-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Racket Lounge
long_description:
Thanks to the incredible support of our enthusiastic audiences, we’re doing a bonus Racket Lounge session, dubbed “Cherry on Top”. And as sweet as a cherry it shall be, featuring some of our most experienced and exciting acts yet! Come celebrate an incredible year of amazing Pōneke talent with us at The Racket Lounge: Cherry on Top.

For those new to The Racket Lounge, it's a top-notch variety show featuring local up-and-coming artists from all genres, from classical, to jazz, to rock. There's something for everyone, and with a choose your price model, everyone can afford to come along and discover their favourite new local artist. We can't wait to see you there!
